passive.name: Perseverance
passive.text: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

spells.name: Decisive Strike
spells.text: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

spells.name: Courage
spells.text: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.

spells.name: Judgment
spells.text: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

spells.name: Demacian Justice
spells.text: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

damage.value: Garen deals sustained physical damage while Judgment spins around him.

archetype.value: Garen is a bruiser who fights nearby enemies and protects himself with Courage.

winCondition.value: Garen closes in with Decisive Strike, deals damage with Judgment, and attempts an execute with Demacian Justice.

spikes.why: Garen gets an early power spike from either item.
Garen charges this powerful keystone quickly with E.
Garen can use its spin more often when its cooldown falls to 6 seconds.

mistakes.value: Garen delays Perseverance’s regeneration by taking damage or being struck by enemy abilities.
